title: Hearing Louis Armstrong at Suburban Gardens
summary: Hug recalls hearing Louis Armstrong around 1931.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: What about Louis Armstrong? Did you hear him when he was at the Samaritan Gardens?
Well, let's see. Yes, I did. That's right. He followed, in fact, I think he came in there a little bit later after this band that I was telling you. Yes, I remember hearing Louis out there.
I was trying to establish that date. I think he was there in 31, so you were quite young.
Well, yes. And it could have been possible that Louis played there after or before. I don't quite remember, as you said, that date. But it was somewhere right around in that time.
